text: {{Trinket infobox | icon = Glob of Condensed Spirit Energy.png | description = This may have reached you when many legendary items were added to your armory. It is of no further consequence and will disappear in time. | type = accessory | rarity = legendary | bound = account | id = 95093 | status = historical }} [[Legendary Equipment Unlocked!]] is a placeholder legendary item which only purpose is to be displayed in legendary acquisition dialog when first logging onto a character that had legendary items equipped or in their inventory after the release of the [[Legendary Armory]] on [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Congrats! Bound legendary items on this character and account bank were automatically converted to unlocks in the Legendary Armory. Now you can enjoy using them across all characters on your account.}} == Notes == * The tooltip of the item displayed in legendary acquisition dialog suggests that it has a place allocated for it in [[Legendary Armory]], because it contains the text "Legendary Armor: Available (0), Unlocked (0) You can unlock 1 more of this item in your Legendary Armory.", but this shouldn't normally be possible since the item is never actually obtained by players. * If linked to chat from the aforementioned dialog, the [[chat link]]'s tooltip displays that the item is a legendary [[Accessory]] that's [[Account Bound|Account Bound on Acquire]] and shows an additional description addressed to players who might've somehow come into possession of this item, all of which is otherwise omitted when the tooltip is displayed in legendary acquisition dialog. [[fr:Équipement légendaire déverrouillé !]]
title: Legendary Equipment Unlocked!
